answer: The saffron schedule is applied in pearl and plume reveals each instalment. A payout is split which means 53% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2188 identities would post 954 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
